newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu gently down vs dlr in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu gently down vs dlr in thin trading.

text.p: 1445 GMT - Romania's leu was 10 units weaker to the dollar at 3,420/35 on Monday on an interbank market unimpressed with first results of Sunday's presidential and parliamentary polls.
* Traders said hard currency shortages had deepened and were unlikely to ease ahead of the second presidential run-off in two weeks time.
* They said they had forecast a centrist opposition win but were still waiting for a clear government programme to emerge.
First results indicate the main Democratic Convention opposition bloc ahead of the parliamentary race with 30 percent compared with around 20 for the now ruling Party of Social Democracy.
* The gap beteen dollar retail prices and interbank rates remained at about 25 percent with currency shop owners saying they expected fresh lows on their market.
* Latest central bank data showed a $50,000 interbank volume last Friday, when overall trading was $8.4 million.
* Short-term rates hovered near 40 percent on an overliquid money market. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
